entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: A demon who poses as a Mul Daya oracle to trick the party into assembling a hedron; he seeks vengeance on Zendikar for destroying his planeswalker spark.

entities.name: Thelzaia
entities.description: A powerful vampire bloodchief, greedy for ancient relics, who guards the second hedron fragment with null zombie minions.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane where the quest takes place, littered with ancient hedrons.

entities.name: Guul Draz
entities.description: A brackish, gloomy jungle region of Zendikar, home to vampires.

entities.name: Malakir
entities.description: The vampire city of Guul Draz that the party strays close to.

entities.name: Pelakka Karst
entities.description: A treacherous system of limestone gullies and murky canals in Zendikar.

entities.name: Hagra Cistern
entities.description: Sinking ancient ruins in a marsh basin fed by the Pelakka Karst, hiding vast treasure and the last hedron piece.

entities.name: Nirkana
entities.description: An outpost near the edge of Guul Draz with a single kor outfitter.

entities.name: Mul Daya
entities.description: A tribe of elves that the hooded oracle falsely claims to belong to.

entities.name: The Hedron
entities.description: An ancient, diamond-shaped stone shattered into pieces across Guul Draz; assembled, it pulses with sinister magic.

entities.name: Pelakka Wurm
entities.description: A wurm that attacks the expedition in the Pelakka Karst.

events.summary: A hooded figure claiming to be an oracle of the Mul Daya tribe gives the party a map into Guul Draz, promising valuable magic.
events.quote: An oracle in a hooded robe, claiming to be of the Mul Daya tribe of elves, gives you a map

events.summary: The party gears up at Nirkana before entering the jungle.
events.quote: you'll need to procure travel gear and supplies

events.summary: The party finds a warded hedron fragment in a marsh grotto.
events.quote: Inside is a fragment of a large, rough-hewn hedron

events.summary: The party stumbles on a vampire hunting party near Malakir.
events.quote: you've stumbled upon a hunting-party of vampires

events.summary: The party is attacked by the Pelakka Wurm in the Karst.
The party finds a second hedron fragment guarded by the bloodchief Thelzaia.
events.quote: But guarding it is Thelzaia, a powerful vampire bloodchief known for her endless greed for ancient relics

events.summary: Swamp crocodiles attack the expedition in the Hagra Cistern marsh and drag a scout under.
events.quote: huge jaws snap open and tear the scout's leg clean off

events.summary: The party reveals the last hedron piece in the Hagra Cistern's vault and assembles the hedron.
events.quote: You unseal the crypt and obtain the last piece of the hedron.

events.summary: The hooded oracle is revealed to be Ob Nixilis, who thanks the party for assembling the hedron.
events.quote: The figure throws off the cloak—it's Ob Nixilis, the dreaded demon.

events.summary: The party strikes down Ob Nixilis and reseals the hedron in the crypt.
events.quote: You strike down Ob Nixilis, who disappears in a haze of black mana.

relations.note: Ob Nixilis lured the party to assemble the hedron to use it for vengeance on Zendikar.
relations.quote: he thanks you for doing the work of bringing together the artifact

relations.note: Thelzaia guards a hedron fragment, being greedy for ancient relics.
relations.quote: But guarding it is Thelzaia, a powerful vampire bloodchief known for her endless greed for ancient relics

relations.note: The Karst surrounds and feeds the basin that holds the Cistern.
relations.quote: The Pelakka Karst surrounds and feeds a vast inland basin
